title: Classify an alternate OBJ task reader
changes: Identify the selected task branches of the previously truncated 0808ada8 draw caller as a reader of the existing 28-byte task pool.
validation: Guarded original-ROM comparisons pin task-pool literals, type-zero and type-one switch targets, identical pre-call selection bytes, both draw targets, and the 28-byte loop stride; evidence: target/validation/units/e129-obj-8ada8-contract-7npoftlr/ and e129-obj-8ada8-bothdraws-c644dhie/.
limitations: No new ROM root, producer, global task domain, other branch, live execution or new runtime acceptance is established. No performance measurement.
